t: You're at the Millennium Sundial in Greenwich Park, a sundial that tells the time by the sun. It was designed by Christopher Daniel, a British sundial designer who lived from 1933 to 2022. Daniel made this one, and it's a fitting piece for Greenwich, a place so closely tied to the measuring of time. On a sunny day, look at where the shadow falls and see what hour it shows. I don't have more details about its construction, so the shadow itself is the best guide.
